name: @gametabletally/web
description: The app at gametabletally.com: a scorekeeper for the game table that works with no connection.

scripts.type-check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p e2e
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
